conventions.features: made parts: chains of coaxial concave cylindrical and conical faces of radius <= 30 mm (ref_features.extract); kind hole = every cylindrical step >= 300 deg; full_step = each >= 300 deg cylinder step of a partial chain alone; point_mm = axis at the chain's opening, dir = into the material; items = what is scored: one per step (radius scored) except in a hole that carries a threaded insert, where the steps of radius <= insert body radius + 0.5 mm form one item 'covered' (axis offset and angle only, matched to a coaxial concave cylinder or cone whose radius lies in radius_window_mm); one covered item per insert axis: where a chain split into two holes holds one insert, the hole behind the insert is not scored (features_not_scored); a step is one surface: faces of one cone (same axis, apex and half-angle) over overlapping axial ranges are one step whose radius is the largest over them; steps_not_scored lists the steps of a hole that are not graded, each with its reason
conventions.frames: given types: principal axes of the anchor constituent (axis_only types: z = the axis of rotation), snapped to the reference axes within 1 deg, origin at the centre of the lower face of the anchor's exact box; the shell: its file frame = the reference frame
conventions.symmetry: turns about local z (orders 2..12) and half turns about local x / y through the middle of the local z extent that map every constituent onto a constituent of equal volume within 0.02 mm
conventions.contact: exact B-rep distance <= 0.05 mm between owners (pairs with the shell: the grader's tessellation)
conventions.interference: common volume > 0.01 mm3 of the grader's tessellations (manifold)
conventions.light: constituent volume < 20 mm3 and not the anchor
conventions.skeleton: per type in its local frame: actuators a directed output axis, rod ends the ball centre, 12 mm pillow blocks the bore centre, other types the centroid; see purchased.<type>.skeleton
conventions.mass: made parts: volume x density of parts_list; given: the data-sheet mass (estimates flagged)
